correctness.rationale: Matched the source Theorem9.3 exact L_{n,r}(q) integral and q minimization (not its separate Poisson-information relaxation). Set Psi(s,r)=n log L(e^s)-s. At origin, isotropic spherical moments E t²=1/n,E t⁴=3/[n(n+2)] give H=2(n-1)(n+1)/[n(n+2)]>0. Independently expanded the source Poisson-gradient radial/tangential numerator nLq(1)-L(1) using parity r->-r,t->-t and moments: Psi_s(0,r)=A r²+O(r4), A=(n-2)(n-1)(3n+2)/[n³(n+2)]. Implicit minimizer displacement -A/H r² and quadratic optimization advantage A²/(2H) r⁴ establish c and delta. Independently integrated source exact formula at n=3,4,5,7 and r=.1,.05 with high precision; scaled derivatives approach the analytic A; numerical checks corroborate but do not prove all n.
